args.title: Summary: Ironbark Retail Returns Logistics (2026) + Companion
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, underscoring the scale of the reverse-logistics challenge in retail.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (20%), showing centralization as a key cost lever.
- Per the companion piece, reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as critical to value recovery.
